items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: In fact, "Up In Dodo's Room" was his line, the one I recorded with Howard McGhee in 1945 I think it was...

ctx.x: called the Bebop movement. He was a very good writer, and played nice piano. Oh, and he was up on all of the tunes and everything. Later on, he wrote arrangements for Lionel Hampton's band. In fact, "Up In Dodo's Room" was his line, the one I recorded with Howard McGhee in 1945 I think it was... That was his line. And it's very, very modern for the time, you know. But he was a little bit nervous type guy, and a lot of people thought he was a little bit off. You know, they (?)called him off(?). But he was…
